contexts.text: As Nimrod, mighty in hunting before Jehovah () = because so many were persuaded... Mighty in hunting = captivating lower minds.
Such were anciently called mighty ones. Illustrated.
In the Original Language, the Word by which mighty one is expressed [means] also a man, which word is predicated of faith, and that in both senses.
The mighty ones of Moab () = those who are in the life of falsity from that love... The mighty ones = things which reign and prevail.
The word by which mighty ones is expressed in the Original Language is predicated of those who are in truth from good; and, in the opposite sense, of those who are in falsity from evil. Illustrated.
By the mighty () are signified those who are in erudition. ( = external truths. AE 408, AE 408:3, Explained.)
